finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache loss took prod down.** One cause, 17 minutes.

| Time UTC | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | Reads hit the store direct. Timeouts start. |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes the 500 cap. |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies. `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 reconnect tries failed with the same `ECONNREFUSED`. Redis never came back. Everything after 02:14:07 is fallout.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
